name: com.opensubtitles/mcp-server
title: OpenSubtitles
description: Search, inspect and download subtitles for movies and TV from OpenSubtitles.com.

tools.name: search_subtitles
tools.description: Find subtitles for a movie or TV episode and get file_ids to download. Search by title (query), video filename, IMDb/TMDB/feature id with optional season/episode, or moviehash; filter by language and flags. Results are ranked with exact title, episode and release-name matches first.

query.description: Title to search for, e.g. "The Matrix". Not needed when an id, moviehash or filename is given.

filename.description: Video filename, e.g. "Chicago.Fire.S14E01.1080p.WEB.h264-ETHEL.mkv". Parsed with guessit-js into title/year/season/episode; its release name ranks matching subtitles first.

imdb_id.description: IMDb id (tt0133093 or 133093). With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB id. With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

feature_id.description: OpenSubtitles feature id from search_features. With season_number/episode_number it is the show's id.

season_number.description: TV season number; use with episode_number and the show's query or id

year.description: Release year, to tell remakes and same-name titles apart

type.description: Restrict to movies or TV episodes

languages.description: Subtitle languages in order of preference, e.g. ["en", "pt-BR"]. Omit for all languages.

items.description: Language code as listed by list_languages, e.g. en, de, pt-BR, zh-CN

moviehash.description: OpenSubtitles hash of the video file (calculate_file_hash in local mode). Exact file matches are flagged moviehash_match and ranked first.

hearing_impaired.description: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH)

foreign_parts_only.description: Subtitles that only cover foreign-language dialogue

order_by.description: relevance = exact title/episode and release-name matches first, then popularity

exact_title.description: When searching by title, first resolve it to the exact movie/show (so "The Matrix" does not return "The Matrix Revisited"). Set false for a fuzzy text search.

tools.name: get_subtitle_details
tools.description: Full metadata for one subtitle from a search result: all files (multi-CD), uploader, comments, links, and related subtitles for the same title and language. Does not use download quota.

feature_id.description: feature.feature_id of the same search result

language.description: The subtitle's language (speeds up the lookup)

related_limit.description: How many related subtitles (same title and language) to return, 0-20

tools.name: download_subtitle
tools.description: Download one subtitle file by file_id and return its text (or a temporary link), with optional format conversion, FPS conversion or time shift. Each call uses one download from the user's daily OpenSubtitles quota, so pick the file with search_subtitles first; the result reports the remaining quota.

sub_format.description: Convert to this format. Omit to keep the original (usually srt).

in_fps.description: Frame rate the subtitle was timed for (use with out_fps)

out_fps.description: Frame rate of your video (use with in_fps)

timeshift.description: Shift all cues by this many seconds, e.g. 2.5 or -1

delivery.description: content = return the subtitle text; link = return only a temporary download URL (for large files or saving to disk)

tools.name: search_features
tools.description: Look up movies, TV shows and episodes on OpenSubtitles (title, year, IMDb/TMDB/feature ids, seasons and episode counts, subtitle counts per language). Use it to disambiguate a title before search_subtitles, or to find a show's seasons and episodes.

type.description: Restrict to movies, TV shows or episodes

include_episodes.description: List every episode (title, feature_id, IMDb id) per season for TV shows

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The subtitle language codes OpenSubtitles supports (e.g. en, pt-BR, zh-CN) with their names. Use the codes in search_subtitles.languages. Also available as the opensubtitles://languages resource.

tools.name: guess_filename
tools.description: Parse a movie or episode filename with guessit-js (title, year, season, episode, release group, resolution, source, codec). Offline and free; use it to build a precise search_subtitles call, or pass the filename to search_subtitles directly.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: The logged-in OpenSubtitles user's level, VIP status, daily download allowance and downloads remaining, so you can plan downloads. Needs a configured login; does not use quota.
